# Eleven Cafē

> A small walk-up espresso bar in downtown Tucson, Arizona: coffee, espresso, teas and Vietnamese iced coffee
> (cà phê sữa đá), each drink made by hand by the owner, Dung "Q" Hoang. Their line: "The hole in the wall that
> fills the gaps in your day."

## What they serve
- Cà phê sữa đá (Vietnamese iced coffee): coffee dripped through a phin onto condensed milk, poured over ice
- Espresso, Americano, cappuccino, lattes, cold brew
- Chai latte, hot cocoa, teas
- Gift cards, at the counter
- No price list is published; ask at the counter

## Where
33 N Stone Ave, Suite 150, Tucson, AZ 85701, at the southeast corner of Church and Pennington.
The door is on Pennington Street.

## Hours
CONFIRM WITH ELEVEN CAFĒ BEFORE PUBLISHING. Google lists Monday to Friday, 7am to 2pm, closed Saturday and Sunday.
